question.text: Pooja is an RTA officer handling post-AGM activities. Which of the following documents and data must she provide after the AGM concludes?

answer.text: Only the votes polled during the AGM e-voting session
Only the remote voting results and proxy forms received
Attendance Register, votes polled in remote voting, and votes polled at the AGM along with results

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook's post-AGM RTA deliverable is the Attendance Register, the votes polled in remote voting, the votes polled at the AGM, and the results thereof. All four items must be provided together. The Trap: Each of the first three options gives only part of the post-AGM package. The workbook treats the attendance data plus both vote categories plus the final results as a single combined deliverable. Note: The post-AGM RTA deliverable of the Attendance Register, votes polled in remote voting, votes polled at the AGM and the results thereof is set out on page 162 of the NISM-Series-II-A Registrars and Transfer Agents (Corporate) Certification Examination workbook (October 2025).
